(:step<arg_key>form</arg_key><arg_value>(:step :op "write" :file "asl/packages/asl-pack/src/pkgIndex.asl" :content "(module aslPack/tests/versionRangeTest\n  :x [runTests]\n  :i [(pkgIndex :a ix)])\n\nfn ! row spec: String ver: String expected: Bool -> (Pair String Bool)\n  (pair (str spec \" @ \" ver) (= (ix/versionSatisfies? (fn [(r (Pair String Bool))] -> Bool (pairSecond r)) (rows))\n            \"every (spec, version, expected) row in the version range table holds\")\n    (assert (listAll? (fn [(r (Pair String Bool))] -> Bool (pairSecond r)) (specRows))\n            \"specValid? accepts the well-formed specs and rejects the malformed ones\")\n    (assert (not (ix/versionSatisfies? \"not-a-version\" \"1.0.0\"))\n            \"a malformed spec is false rather than an error\")\n    (assert (ix/versionSatisfies? \">=1.0 <2.0 || >=3.1\" \"3.2.0\")\n            \"an || alternative matches when the first conjunction does not\")\n    true))\n")
```
(module aslPack/pkgIndex
  :x [Artefact Dep Version Pkg Index normVersion caretPrefixEq mapResult kvFind strField listField atomText unquote validName? validVersion? validSha? validTriple? validSpec? specValid? versionParts versionCompare versionSatisfies? findPkg findVersion highestMatching artefactFor parseIndex parseRequest]
  :i [(asl-parser/reader :a rd)])

(schema Artefact (:f triple String) (:f url String) (:f sha256 String))
(schema Dep (:f name String) (:f spec String))
(schema Version (:f v String) (:f artefacts (List Artefact)) (:f source (List Artefact)) (:f deps (List Dep)))
(schema Pkg (:f name String) (:f versions (List Version)))
(schema Index (:f pkgs (List Pkg)) (:f diags (List String)))

fn mapResult f: (fn [A] -> (Result B String)) xs: (List A) -> (Result (List B) String)
  (match (listHead xs)
    ((none) (ok (list)))
    ((some h)
     (match (f h)
       ((err e) (err e))
       ((ok y)
        (match (mapResult f (optionOr (listTail xs) (list)))
          ((err e) (err e))
          ((ok ys) (ok (cons y ys))))))))

fn unquote s: String -> String
  (if (and (>= (stringLength s) 2) (and (stringStartsWith? s "\"") (stringEndsWith? s "\"")))
    (optionOr (stringSlice s 1 (- (stringLength s) 1)) "")
    s) :rawFields "content")
(:step :op "write" :file "asl/packages/asl-pack/tests/versionRangeTest.asl" :content "(module aslPack/pkgIndex\n  :x [Artefact Dep Version Pkg Index normVersion caretPrefixEq mapResult kvFind strField listField atomText unquote validName? c: String -> Bool\n  (let [(n (charCode c))]\n    (or (and (>= n 97) (<= n 122)) (or (and (>= n 48) (<= n 57)) (= n 45)))))\n\nfn digitChar? c: String -> Bool\n  (let [(n (charCode c))]\n    (and (>= n 48) (<= n 57))))\n\nfn hexChar? (stringChars s)) (not (stringStartsWith? s \"-\")))))\n\nfn validVersionPart? s: String -> Bool\n  (and (and (not (stringEmpty? s)) (<= (stringLength s) 9)) (listAll? digitChar? (stringChars s))))\n\nfn validVersion? s: String -> Bool\n  (let [(parts (stringSplit s \".\"))]\n    (and (and (>= (listLength parts) 1) (<= (listLength parts) 4)) (listAll? validVersionPart? parts))))\n\nfn validSha? s: String -> Bool\n  (and (= (stringLength s) 64) (listAll? hexChar? (stringChars s))))\n\nfn validTriple? s: String -> Bool\n  (and (and (not (stringEmpty? s)) (<= (stringLength s) 40)) (listAll? tripleChar? (stringChars s))))\n\n; (:m :ref PKG-CLIENT :do \"a spec is one or more || alternatives; each alternative is one or more space-separated terms; a term is * or an operator prefix (>= <= > < ~ ^ =) or a bare exact version; anything else is malformed and specValid? is false\")\nfn specBody spec: String -> String\n  (cond\n    ((stringStartsWith? spec \">=\") (optionOr (stringSlice spec 2 (stringLength spec)) \"\"))\n    ((stringStartsWith? spec \"<=\") (optionOr (stringSlice spec 2 (stringLength spec)) \"\"))\n    ((stringStartsWith? spec \">\") (optionOr (stringSlice spec 1 (stringLength spec)) \"\"))\n    ((stringStartsWith? spec \"<\") (optionOr (stringSlice spec 1 (stringLength spec)) \"\"))\n    ((stringStartsWith? spec \"~\") (optionOr (stringSlice spec 1 (stringLength spec)) \"\"))\n    ((stringStartsWith? spec \"^\") (optionOr (stringSlice spec 1 (stringLength spec)) \"\"))\n    ((stringStartsWith? spec \"=\") (optionOr (stringSlice spec 1 (stringLength spec)) \"\"))\n    (else spec)))\n\nfn specTerms s: String -> (List String)\n  (filter (fn [(term String)] -> Bool (not (stringEmpty? term)))\n          (stringSplit (stringTrim s) \" \")))\n\nfn validTerm? term: String -> Bool\n  (or (= term \"*\") (validVersion? a) (listEmpty? b)) 0\n    (let [(x (optionOr (listHead a) 0)) (y (optionOr (listHead b) 0))]\n      (cond\n        ((< x y) -1)\n        ((> x y) 1)\n        (else (versionCompare (optionOr (listTail a) (list)) (optionOr (listTail b) (list))))))))\n\nfn padTo parts: (List Int64) k: Int64 -> (List Int64)\n  (if (>= (listLength parts) k) parts (padTo (listAppend parts (list 0)) k)))\n\nfn firstNonZero parts: (List Int64) i: Int64 -> Int64\n  (cond\n    ((listEmpty?
